title: Sessionizer mod.json
description: What Herdr reads from the Sessionizer's mod.json, and the settings it takes. Saving the file reloads the mod.

settings.description: Your changes. A setting left out uses its default.

roots.title: Roots
roots.description: Folders whose subfolders are listed. A string, or { path, depth, optional } where optional skips a missing folder without a warning. Empty: the home folder.

depth.title: Depth
depth.description: How many levels below each root are listed, for roots that don't set their own.

hidden.title: Hidden folders
hidden.description: List folders whose name starts with a dot. node_modules is never listed.

open_spaces.title: Open spaces
open_spaces.description: List the open spaces above the folders.

hide_open_folders.title: Hide open folders
hide_open_folders.description: Leave out a folder an open space is already in.

ssh_space.title: SSH space
ssh_space.description: Name of the space that holds one tab per ssh host.

ssh_config.title: SSH config
ssh_config.description: The ssh config whose Host aliases are listed, Include files too.

keys.title: Keys
keys.description: Keys for each action, written like "ctrl-n" or "down". Esc closes and Enter opens.
